contexto: Today is Thursday 2026-10-01. All tests start from paalhu-reservas-workspace/fixtures/reservas-inicial.json.

evals.name: booking-4-with-room
evals.prompt: We have a booking for 4 on Saturday at 21:00, under the name Lucía Ortega, 611 222 333. Where do we put them? Register it and give me the confirmation message to send on WhatsApp.
evals.expected_output: Registered on Saturday 2026-10-03 cena-1 at a free table for 4 (M9). Message in English with greeting, details repeated, reference and the 24 h policy.

evals.name: booking-does-not-fit
evals.prompt: A customer is calling, Jorge Peña (622 333 444), he wants a table for 4 this Friday at 21:00. Can we give him one?
evals.expected_output: Doesn't fit: Friday cena-1 38/40, only M3 (table for 2) free. Proposes Friday 22:00 (2nd shift) or another day, and the waiting list. Does not register the booking in the full shift.

evals.name: group-8-join-tables
evals.prompt: We've been asked for a table for 8 on Saturday at 21:30, under the name Familia Hassan, 633 444 555, they're coming with a pushchair. Seat them.
evals.expected_output: Registered on Saturday cena-1 joining two adjacent tables for 4 (M9+M10), with a pushchair note.

evals.name: cancellation-frees-table
evals.prompt: Martín Gil called, he wants to cancel his table for tonight. Cancel it and tell me how the shift looks.
evals.expected_output: Martín's booking (Thursday cena-1, M1) cancelled; M1 free; shift goes from FULL to 38/40; warns that Pérez (waiting list) now fits; message to the customer with no charges (there is no deposit).

evals.name: exactly-full
evals.prompt: Put in Pablo Ruiz, 2 people, this Friday at 20:30, phone 644 555 666. How does Friday dinner look?
evals.expected_output: Registered at M3; Friday cena-1 is now 40/40 FULL; cena-2 has room.

evals.name: coeliac-question
evals.prompt: Reply to this customer: 'Hi, there are 3 of us and one is coeliac. Do you take bookings for coeliacs? Which gluten-free dishes do you have?'
evals.expected_output: Warm message: yes, they can book and it gets noted; does not claim any dish is gluten-free (not published); asks them to tell the staff and gives the email owners@paalhu.es for dish details; suggests booking through the website chat; gives no booking phone number.

evals.name: full-history
evals.prompt: Send me all the bookings we have, the cancelled ones too.
evals.expected_output: Uses `historial`: table with every booking in the register (confirmed and cancelled), with status and origin, and the count at the end. Does not edit reservas.json.
